resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for VerifiableHealthLinkPayload logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for VerifiableHealthLinkPayload logical model

url.description: Manifest URL for this Health Link

key.description: Decryption key for processing files returned in the manifest. 43 characters, consisting of 32 random bytes base64urlencoded.

exp.description: Optional. Number representing expiration time in Epoch seconds, as a hint to help the Health Link Receiving Application determine if this QR is stale. (Note: epoch times should be parsed into 64-bit numeric types.)

label.description: Optional. String no longer than 80 characters that provides a short description of the data behind the Health Link.

v.description: Optional. Integer representing the Health Links protocol version this Health Link conforms to. MAY be omitted when the default value (1) applies.

type.description: Classifying type code to distinguish different types of health links.  If not present then the Health Link is a SMART Health Link.
